visualizations.title: NyxID 凭证流 · 明文密钥直连对照零密钥代理
visualizations.title_en: NyxID credential flow · raw keys in the agent against a zero-secret proxy
visualizations.summary: 同一次调用、同一条带毒的工具响应，同时走两条通道：上方的传统直连把 k 项服务的明文密钥放在智能体环境里，下方是 NyxID 的四层零密钥代理（智能体运行时 → 受限能力令牌 → NyxID 代理与策略引擎 → 上游服务）。直连的泄露面随挂载服务数 k（1 到 55）线性增长，NyxID 一侧智能体能读到的明文密钥对每个 k、每种工况都是 0。另有约 2.1 s 的凭证热重载（沙箱 0 次重启）与 1 credit = 1 USD 的逐笔计量和单代理封顶。架构数字按 2026-11-27 核对的线上 v0.78.0：55 项内置服务、42 份 OpenAPI→MCP 规范、9 类消息渠道（dev 0.79.0 扩到 11 类，尚未上线）。四张实验卡在第一章与第四章按卡引用；示意模型，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: The same call and the same poisoned tool response travel two lanes at once: legacy wiring that keeps plaintext keys for k services in the agent's environment, and NyxID's four-layer zero-secret proxy (agent runtime → scoped capability token → NyxID proxy and policy engine → upstream service). The legacy blast radius grows linearly with the number k of attached services (1 to 55); on the NyxID side the agent can read 0 plaintext secrets for every k and every scenario. Also: a hot credential reload of about 2.1 s with 0 sandbox restarts, and metering at 1 credit = 1 USD with a per-agent ceiling. Architecture numbers follow live v0.78.0 as checked on 2026-11-27: 55 built-in services, 42 OpenAPI→MCP specs, 9 messaging channel types (dev 0.79.0 extends this to 11, not yet live). Four experiment cards are cited from chapters 1 and 4; a schematic model, not a proof.

visualizations.title: 变更判官 · 只测改动碰到的边
visualizations.title_en: Harness delta judge · test only what the change touches
visualizations.summary: 一张 14 个单元的声明式 FILEMAP 依赖图。点任一单元把它标为已改动，DELTA 沿登记的消费边逐层做广度优先展开，选出必须重判的单元、跳过其余，并按成本权重（全仓合计 100）算出省下的验证量：只改一章正文选中 2 / 14、省 86%，改核心内核传递到 9 / 14。政策轨道与产品同改时亮出品红的 policy.mixed-warning，改动里有未登记文件时 registry.explicit 直接报错，不猜、不退回全量。按 chrono-harness 的规则建模（截至 2026-11-27 迁至 github.com/chrono-harness：25 个公开仓库、每平台 21 个预编译二进制、29 条原子规则，completeness_proven: false 照实保留）；四张实验卡在第六章按卡引用；示意模型，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: A declarative FILEMAP of 14 units. Mark any unit as changed and DELTA expands breadth-first along the registered consumer edges, level by level, selects the units that must be judged again, skips the rest and computes the verification it saves from the cost weights (100 for the whole repository): one prose chapter selects 2 / 14 and saves 86%, the core kernel reaches 9 / 14. A change to the policy track together with product units raises the magenta policy.mixed-warning, and a file missing from the registry makes registry.explicit fail with an explicit error, with no guess and no fallback to a full run. Modelled on the rules of chrono-harness (as of 2026-11-27 at github.com/chrono-harness: 25 public repositories, 21 prebuilt binaries per platform, 29 atomic rules, with completeness_proven: false kept as it stands); four experiment cards are cited from chapter 6; a schematic model, not a proof.
